programme.title: VOCM-AM 590
programme.desc: VOCM is an AM radio station in St. John's, Newfoundland and Labrador, Canada, broadcasting at 590 kHz. Owned by Stingray Group, VOCM first went on the air on October 19, 1936. Through the "VOCM/Big Land FM Radio Network" of stations owned by Stingray, VOCM programming is carried throughout the province.

programme.title: Customer Wars - Caught in the Act
programme.desc: S7E12 - In Maryville, Tennessee, a man in a wheelchair confronts two customers for blocking a handicap ramp; at a fast-food restaurant in College Park, Georgia, an employee is reportedly threatened by her ex-girlfriend who shows up. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Doorstep Justice
programme.desc: S6E6 - In Orem, Utah, tempers flare when a neighbor lashes out at a construction crew for playing music while they work; in Hollywood, Fla., a shoplifting suspect flees from police, leading to a dramatic on-foot chase. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Customer Wars - Superstore Sprinter
programme.desc: S5E14 - In Bogotá, Colombia, a tardy traveler's attempt to board a departing flight ends in a confrontation with authorities; outside a superstore in Kent, Washington, a shoplifting suspect is confronted by police. (Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Christmas Wars - Claus and Effect
programme.desc: S1E1 - In California, a paragliding Santa Claus has a head on collision with a power line; fists fly between two Black Friday shoppers at a mall in Kentucky; a Colorado driver chases down a delivery truck sprinkling the highway with last-minute gifts. (Holiday, Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Christmas Wars - Sleigh It Ain't So
programme.desc: S2E1 - A man dressed as Santa watches four women duke it out in a Massachusetts mall; a woman in Canada wrestles with a large hedge in what may be an attempt to get a free Christmas tree; a pregnant waitress in Pennsylvania gets an unexpected surprise. (Holiday, Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Christmas Wars - Deer Santa
programme.desc: S1E2 - A parachuting Santa crash lands at a beach in Florida; an out of control giant balloon wreaks havoc at the Thanksgiving Day Parade in NYC; a Florida woman's Christmas tree is taken over by a mysterious furry visitor. (Holiday, Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Christmas Wars - Crashing Through the Snow
programme.desc: S2E2 - A woman, fresh from a holiday party in Illinois, stands in the middle of the road and dares police to arrest her; a Christmas gift turns terrifying when it spontaneously bursts into flames inside a small Belgium apartment. (Holiday, Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Christmas Wars - Worst Christmas Ever
programme.desc: S2E4 - Workers installing a massive Christmas light display in New Zealand run into some extremely dangerous equipment issues; two co-workers at a retail store come to blows during a holiday party. (Holiday, Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Christmas Wars - Merry Prankmas
programme.desc: S2E3 - A family in Canada cuts down a Christmas tree, with unintended consequences; in Washington, a woman pranks her grinchy husband with the assistance of their whole neighborhood; a Wisconsin woman discovers that some deals are too good to be true. (Holiday, Reality, Documentary)

programme.title: Storage Wars - The War of the Riaches
programme.desc: S18E5 - In Fullerton, Dusty drags a busy Lupe to the auction, where she decides to show him that "packed" isn't always "stacked;" Dave refuses to let KinderCare influence his choices, while Emily, intent on following the mystery, ends up short a wheel. (Reality, Auction, Collectibles)

programme.title: Storage Wars - Cheesy Does It!

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: This follow-up to the popular "Teen Titans" series takes a more comedic look at the superheroes, showing what life is like for the teens when their capes come off. Funny things happen to Robin, Starfire, Raven, Beast Boy and Cyborg between saving the world and being regular teens, living together without adult supervision. The teens, in their ordinary lives, deal with the everyday issues of adolescence that include such important things as having staring contests to determine who does the laundry and going on a series of quests to construct the perfect sandwich. But, of course, the heroes still fight crime in Jump City when the need arises. Whatever the situation, they're always ready for an adventure -- inside the house or out of it. (family)

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 1
programme.desc: Without the guidance and protection of their professors, Harry (Daniel Radcliffe), Ron (Rupert Grint) and Hermione (Emma Watson) begin a mission to destroy the Horcruxes, the sources of Voldemort's immortality. Though they must rely on one another more than ever, dark forces threaten to tear them apart. Voldemort's Death Eaters have seized control of the Ministry of Magic and Hogwarts, and they are searching for Harry -- even as he and his friends prepare for the ultimate showdown. - Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Ralph Fiennes, Alan Rickman (movie)

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows: Part 2
programme.desc: A clash between good and evil awaits as young Harry, Ron and Hermione prepare for a final battle against Lord Voldemort. Harry has grown into a steely lad on a mission to rid the world of evil. The friends must search for the Horcruxes that keep the dastardly wizard immortal. Harry and Voldemort meet at Hogwarts Castle for a showdown where the forces of darkness may finally meet their match. - Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Ralph Fiennes, Alan Rickman (movie)

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
programme.desc: Harry Potter's third year at Hogwarts starts off badly when he learns deranged killer Sirius Black has escaped from Azkaban prison and is bent on murdering the teenage wizard. While Hermione's cat torments Ron's sickly rat, causing a rift among the trio, a swarm of nasty Dementors is sent to protect the school from Black. A mysterious new teacher helps Harry learn to defend himself, but what is his secret tie to Sirius Black? - Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Gary Oldman, David Thewlis (movie)

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
programme.desc: During Harry's fourth year at Hogwarts a competition will be held between three schools of wizardry, and contestants will be magically chosen for the very dangerous event. - Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Robbie Coltrane, Ralph Fiennes (movie)

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
programme.desc: Now in his fifth year at Hogwarts, Harry learns that many in the wizarding community do not know the truth of his encounter with Lord Voldemort. Cornelius Fudge, Minister of Magic, appoints his toady, Dolores Umbridge, as Defense Against the Dark Arts teacher, for he fears that professor Dumbledore will take his job. But her teaching is deficient and her methods, cruel, so Harry prepares a group of students to defend the school against a rising tide of evil. - Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Helena Bonham Carter, Robbie Coltrane (movie)

programme.title: Harry Potter and the Half-Blood Prince
programme.desc: As Death Eaters wreak havoc in both Muggle and Wizard worlds, Hogwarts is no longer a safe haven for students. Teenage hormones run rampant through Hogwarts, presenting a different sort of danger. Love may be in the air, but tragedy looms and Hogwarts may never be the same again. - Daniel Radcliffe, Rupert Grint, Emma Watson, Helena Bonham Carter, Jim Broadbent (movie)

She's suspended, fined, and can only practice law again if she finds a senior lawyer who is willing to take her on and mentor her for a one year probationary period. Only one man is willing to take that risk: Harry Svensson, who runs the top family law practice in the city. He also happens to be Abby's estranged father, who left Abby and her complicated mother for his secretary when Abby was seven. Thus begins the odd dynamic at Abigail's new workplace. programme.desc: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). But Maverick isn't only competing to be the top fighter pilot, he's also fighting for the attention of his beautiful flight instructor, Charlotte Blackwood (Kelly McGillis). - Tom Cruise, Kelly McGillis, Anthony Edwards, Val Kilmer, Tom Skerritt (movie)

However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S. - Sean Connery, Alec Baldwin, Scott Glenn, Sam Neill, James Earl Jones (movie)

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. programme.desc: His heart recently broken, plastic surgeon Danny Maccabee (Adam Sandler) pretends to be married so he can enjoy future dates with no strings attached. programme.title: The Godfather

programme.title: The Godfather Part II

programme.desc: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. - Michael C. Hall, Jack Alcott, James Remar, Uma Thurman, Ntare Guma Mbaho Mwine (Crime drama, Mystery)

programme.title: Seabiscuit

programme.title: The Outsiders

Thomas Howell) and Johnny (Ralph Macchio) get into a brawl that ends in the death of a Social member, the boys are forced to go into hiding. programme.title: Dexter: Resurrection
programme.desc: Dexter Morgan awakens from a coma and sets out for New York City, determined to find Harrison and make things right. - Michael C. Hall, Jack Alcott, James Remar, Uma Thurman, Ntare Guma Mbaho Mwine (Crime drama, Mystery)

Johnson), Downs must race against time during a wild and restless night to save him and bring the criminals to justice. - Jamie Foxx, Michelle Monaghan, T.I., Dermot Mulroney, Gabrielle Union (movie)

programme.title: The Godfather Part II

Frantz (Dylan McDermott) and composed of both seasoned troops and new recruits, attempts to take a hill during the Vietnam War. programme.title: Top Gun
programme.desc: The Top Gun Naval Fighter Weapons School is where the best of the best train to refine their elite flying skills. When hotshot fighter pilot Maverick (Tom Cruise) is sent to the school, his reckless attitude and cocky demeanor put him at odds with the other pilots, especially the cool and collected Iceman (Val Kilmer). programme.title: Day of the Fight

Pitt, Joe Pesci, Ron Perlman, Steve Buscemi, Nicolette Robinson (movie)

programme.title: Ballistic
programme.desc: Beck, a homeless veteran, learns his sister's killer is free after early prison release, sparking his quest for revenge. - James Jaysen Bryhan, David Lamont, Carl Wharton, Damien Lanceley, Christopher Torretto (movie)

programme.title: World Trade Center
programme.desc: Two Port Authority officers, Sgt. John McLoughlin (Nicolas Cage) and Officer Will Jimeno (Michael Peña), become trapped in the rubble of the World Trade Center after going in to help people escape from the buildings during the terrorist attacks of Sept. 11, 2001. - Nicolas Cage, Michael Peña, Maggie Gyllenhaal, Maria Bello, Stephen Dorff (movie)

programme.title: Homestead
programme.desc: A former green beret and other survivors take refuge inside an elaborate compound when an attack on America leaves the world in chaos. - Bailey Chase, Neal McDonough, Dawn Olivieri, Kearran Giovanni, Olivia Sanabia (movie)

programme.title: The Harvest

With time running out, the injured pilot's commanding officer (Gene Hackman) goes against orders to carry out a desperate rescue mission. - Owen Wilson, Gene Hackman, Gabriel Macht, Charles Malik Whitfield, Joaquim de Almeida (movie)

programme.title: Stop-Loss

Unexpectedly, the Army invokes a clause in Brandon's military contract, requiring him to return to active duty in Iraq. With the help of close friend Michele, Brandon goes AWOL and struggles to find a way out of the dilemma. - Ryan Phillippe, Abbie Cornish, Channing Tatum, Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Ciarán Hinds (movie)

programme.title: Dunkirk

Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. programme.title: Fist Fight

As news of the showdown spreads like wildfire, poor Andy desperately seeks any way out of his date with certain doom. - Charlie Day, Ice Cube, Tracy Morgan, Jillian Bell, Dean Norris (movie)

programme.title: Rush Hour 2

Ricky Tan (John Lone), head of the Fu-Cang-Long Triad, sends out his minions to ensure that Carter and Lee don't solve the case. - Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, John Lone, Zhang Ziyi, Roselyn Sánchez (movie)

programme.title: Rush Hour 3
programme.desc: East meets West when the assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord. - Jackie Chan, Chris Tucker, Hiroyuki Sanada, Yûki Kudô, Max Von Sydow (movie)

programme.title: Private Parts

Landing a gig in Washington, D.C., Stern meets Robin Quivers (herself), who will become his long-time partner in crime. When the two move to New York, they face the wrath of NBC executives. - Mary McCormack, Fred Norris, Paul Giamatti, Carol Alt, Richard Portnow (movie)

programme.title: Killer Joe
programme.desc: A cop (Matthew McConaughey) who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister (Juno Temple). - Matthew McConaughey, Emile Hirsch, Juno Temple, Gina Gershon, Thomas Haden Church (movie)

programme.title: Domestic Disturbance

But Frank is the only one who believes him. Now the father Danny trusts must protect him from the stepfather he fears. - John Travolta, Vince Vaughn, Teri Polo, Matt O'Leary, Ruben Santiago-Hudson (movie)

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past. - Russell Crowe, Karen Gillan, Marton Csokas, Thomas M. Wright, Harry Greenwood (movie)

programme.title: Queen of the Damned

His music wakes Akasha (Aaliyah), the queen of all vampires, and inspires her desire to make Lestat her king. Akasha's malevolent power is so great that all the immortal vampires must stand against her if they want to survive. Meanwhile, a young London woman with a fascination for the dark side (Marguerite Moreau) falls in love with Lestat. - Stuart Townsend, Aaliyah, Marguerite Moreau, Vincent Perez, Paul McGann (movie)

The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect. - Michael Douglas, Gwyneth Paltrow, Viggo Mortensen, David Suchet, Sarita Choudhury (movie)

As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive. - Leonardo DiCaprio, Mark Ruffalo, Ben Kingsley, Max von Sydow, Michelle Williams (movie)

programme.title: Noah

Noah must build an ark large enough to hold his wife (Jennifer Connelly), adopted daughter (Emma Watson), sons (Logan Lerman, Douglas Booth, Leo McHugh Carroll) and their wives -- plus breeding pairs of every animal. When the task is completed, Noah and his family witness God's wrath in the form of an apocalyptic flood. - Russell Crowe, Jennifer Connelly, Emma Watson, Anthony Hopkins, Ray Winstone (movie)

programme.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
programme.desc: Evil Judge Turpin (Alan Rickman) lusts for the beautiful wife of a London barber (Johnny Depp) and transports him to Australia for a crime he did not commit. Though many fall to his blade, he will not be satisfied until he slits Turpin's throat. - Johnny Depp, Helena Bonham Carter, Alan Rickman, Timothy Spall, Sacha Baron Cohen (movie)

programme.title: Sweetness
programme.desc: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love. - Kate Hallett, Herman Tømmeraas, Aya Furukawa, Justin Chatwin, Steven Ogg (movie)

programme.title: The Equalizer 2

Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him. - Denzel Washington, Pedro Pascal, Ashton Sanders, Bill Pullman, Melissa Leo (movie)

programme.title: A Wonderful Time of the Year
programme.desc: The Marsh family's getting together for their first Christmas Eve after three years of pandemic lockdown. - Kelly Kruger, Brendan Penny, Tom Arnold, Lisa Hartman, Tina Simmons (movie)

programme.title: Beastly

programme.title: Star Trek VI: The Undiscovered Country

James Kirk (William Shatner) and the crew of the USS Enterprise are carrying Klingon Chancellor Gorkon (David Warner) to Earth to negotiate a peace treaty with the United Federation of Planets. Austin, Lisa Kudrow, Kevin Dillon, Don Cheadle (movie)

programme.title: Star Trek II: The Wrath of Khan
programme.desc: As Adm. James T. Kirk (William Shatner) and Capt. Spock (Leonard Nimoy) monitor trainees at Starfleet Academy, another vessel from the United Federation of Planets is about to try out the planet-creating Genesis Device in a seemingly deserted portion of space. programme.title: Event Horizon

programme.title: The Lost Boys

programme.title: Anaconda
programme.desc: Filmmaker Terri Flores is travelling deep in the Amazon jungle looking for a forgotten tribe. He offers to help them find the tribe, but his secretive behaviour puts everyone on edge. They realise too late that he's using them to find a legendary anaconda that's worth a fortune, if they can catch it.

programme.title: Arrival

programme.title: Mad Max Beyond Thunderdome

They follow the Yellow Brick Road toward the Emerald City to meet the Wizard, and en route they meet a Scarecrow that needs a brain, a Tin Man missing a heart, and a Cowardly Lion who wants courage. The wizard asks the group to bring him the broom of the Wicked Witch of the West to earn his help. - Judy Garland, Frank Morgan, Ray Bolger, Bert Lahr, Jack Haley (movie)

programme.title: Red One
programme.desc: When a villain kidnaps Santa Claus from the North Pole, an E.L.F. (Extremely Large and Formidable) operative joins forces with the world's most accomplished tracker to find him and save Christmas. - Dwayne Johnson, Chris Evans, J.K. Simmons, Lucy Liu, Kiernan Shipka (movie)

programme.title: Elf
programme.desc: Buddy (Will Ferrell) was accidentally transported to the North Pole as a toddler and raised to adulthood among Santa's elves. Unable to shake the feeling that he doesn't fit in, the adult Buddy travels to New York, in full elf uniform, in search of his real father. As it happens, this is Walter Hobbs (James Caan), a cynical businessman. After a DNA test proves this, Walter reluctantly attempts to start a relationship with the childlike Buddy with increasingly chaotic results. - Will Ferrell, James Caan, Bob Newhart, Edward Asner, Mary Steenburgen (movie)
